description: This Java source file defines a utility class `RootSupervisorStrategyFactory` that creates an Akka supervision strategy (`OneForOneStrategy`) for root actors, particularly tailored to handle different exception scenarios with specific restart, resume, or escalation behaviors.

classes.name: RootSupervisorStrategyFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to create a supervision strategy configured to handle specific actor exceptions.

methods.name: createStrategy
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured `OneForOneStrategy` for supervising child actors, with custom handlers for various exceptions and error conditions.
